text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a triumphant debut race, Air
Groove returns
amidst resounding
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I hope you're not getting lax.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is nothing but the beginning. I
expect you to
do your best tomorrow
and onward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We leave Sapporo Racecourse and head
to the
airport to return to Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There's something that I forgot to do.
Stay here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious what Air Groove is up to, so I
watch
her from a distance.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Congratulations on your
debut!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... I wanted to tell you in person.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Your support is what allowed
me to
give it my all today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're so... regal... when you run. So
confident...
You were amazing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you nervous with all that
attention on
you even before you
started running?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was. However, I transform the weight of
that
attention into responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Responsibility?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The responsibility to run in a
manner
befitting a reigning empress.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I embrace my anxieties and transform
them into
strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anxieties... into strength...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've only just made my debut. There's
still a long
road to travel before I reach
the ideals I strive
for.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Set your sights on your own debut and
do your
best. I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Right! I will! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't recall asking you to follow me. In
fact, I
think I told you to stay put.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh... No matter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully you understand the weight
that I bear
now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It will only grow from here on.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This encumbrance falls not only upon
me, as
you'll find out soon enough.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This bears repeating—don't get lax.
And...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Stay with me, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I offer a reassuring nod. Our journey's
only just
begun!
